text: All shares of OAO Russian Railways are owned by the Russian Federation (RZD charter, clause 32).

source.name: RZD Charter (via Wayback Machine, company.rzd.ru)
source.quote: Все акции общества находятся в собственности Российской Федерации.

additionalSources.name: Sanctions Finder: entry for Open Joint Stock Company Russian Railways (US E.O. 14024 listing)
additionalSources.quote: OFAC identified the following 11 Russian entities as being owned or controlled by, or having acted or purposed to act for or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, the GoR: Open Joint Stock Company Russian Railways
additionalSources.note: Sanctions Finder reproduces the official US Treasury reason (home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy0608): OFAC identified Russian Railways as owned or controlled by the Government of the Russian Federation. Opened 3 Oct 2026.
